description: This file defines the LruMemoryCache class, a specific implementation of a least recently used (LRU) cache in Drupal, managing cache items in memory with slot limitations and cache eviction policies.

classes.name: LruMemoryCache
classes.description: A cache class implementing least recently used (LRU) eviction policy, extending MemoryCache.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with a time service and allowed slot count.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache item by ID and updates its position as most recently used.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cache items and updates their positions as most recently used.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Adds or updates a cache item, evicting least recently used if necessary.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates a cache item by ID.

methods.name: invalidateMultiple
methods.description: Invalidates multiple cache items by their IDs.

methods.name: invalidateTags
methods.description: Invalidates cache items associated with specific tags.

methods.name: moveItemsToLeastRecentlyUsed
methods.description: Reorders cache items to mark them as least recently used.
